name: excel-index-match
description: How to use INDEX&MATCH for two-dimensional lookups in Excel via openpyxl. Use this skill whenever building Excel formulas that look up values by matching both a row criterion and a column criterion from a data table — e.g., matching a series code (row) and a year (column). Trigger when the user mentions VLOOKUP&MATCH, HLOOKUP&MATCH, XLOOKUP&MATCH, INDEX&MATCH, or two-condition lookups.
